title: [v0.92][WP-04.08] Fencing and single-owner enforcement
body:
## Summary

- enforce quorum-authorized durable Fence and Revoke floors at mutation admission
- verify current lease authority, expiry, activation possession, epoch semantics, and monotonic checkpoint state
- reject rollback, stale handles, unsafe persistence cleanup, replay, and capacity failures with exact retained proof
